materials.name: 85N
materials.peel_condition: 1 oz, after thermal stress (7.1 lb/in); also at elevated temperature and after process solutions

lamination.notes: Pre-vacuum 30-45 min; heat rise 4-6 C/min (8-12 F/min) between 65 and 121 C; vacuum lamination preferred. Start-point pressures by panel size: 275 psi (12 x 18 in), 350 psi (16 x 18 in), 400 psi (18 x 24 in); with 29 in vacuum 200, 250 and 300 psi. Product temperature at start of cure 218 C (425 F), cure time 2.0 h, cool down under pressure at 5 C/min or less.

drilling.retract_notes: Drill at 400-500 SFM; undercut bits are recommended for vias of 0.018 in and smaller.

processing.desmear_note: Alkaline permanganate or plasma with settings for polyimide; plasma is preferred for positive etchback.
processing.bake_note: Bake inner layers 60 min at 107-121 C before lay-up; bake 1-2 h at 121 C before HASL reflow.

materials.notes: T260, T288 and T300 are each published as more than 60 min (bounds, not stored); Td 387 C initial and 407 C at 5 % loss; Tg above 250 C. Young's modulus 3.2 Mpsi (column unit ambiguous in the sheet, not stored); Poisson's ratio 0.15. The sheet covers the laminate and the prepreg; the glass styles are in the 85N Prepreg record.

materials.name: 85N Prepreg
materials.notes: Resin content 72, 63, 55, 50 and 40 % (+/- 3) for the styles 106, 1080, 2313, 2116 and 7628; Arlon part numbers 85N0672, 85N8063, 85N2355, 85N2650 and 85N2840. Scaled flow Hf 1.7, 2.4, 3.4, 4.1 and 6.6 mils (+/- 0.3) and DeltaH 0.75 mil (0.70 for 7628), both +/- 0.20. Store at 60-70 F at or below 30 % RH; vacuum desiccate 8-12 h before lamination.
